definition.question: How far has domestic substitution eroded the effectiveness of frontier-AI chip and lithography export controls?
definition.low_end: Export controls effectively deny frontier AI-relevant compute with no viable domestic lithography alternatives at scale.
definition.high_end: Export controls are fully ineffective as domestic alternatives fully substitute at scale for frontier AI-relevant chip production.

readings.rationale: Early domestic immersion DUV manufacturing has begun (5 systems targeted in 2026, ~20 in 2027 for SMIC/Hua Hong/CXMT) but tools still require further testing and remain far from ASML on performance/reliability with no fab qualification or sustained procurement shift yet; would be higher with demonstrated high-yield qualification and ASML displacement, lower if targets slip or tools remain low-end…
